name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd

ledger.quote: Hopefully, we should be able to file the product before the end of this calendar year.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.target: file Ilumya PsA before end of calendar year
ledger.verdict: Ilumya PsA sBLA filing targeted for H2 FY26 received no update.

ledger.quote: We are planning to launch UNLOXCYT in the US in the second half of FY'26.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.target: launch UNLOXCYT in US in second half of FY26
ledger.verdict: UNLOXCYT launched in the US in second half of FY26 as committed.
ledger.evidence: Unloxcyt was launched earlier this year. The early feedback from health care professionals, including oncologists and dermatologists continues to be positive

ledger.quote: If we plan, we will see some impact this year, this fiscal year.
ledger.speaker: Richard Ascroft
ledger.target: revenue impact from Leqselvi this fiscal year
ledger.verdict: Leqselvi launched in FY26 and achieved over 1,000 prescribers by June 2026.
ledger.evidence: In the month of June, we surpassed 1,000 prescribers, and we also delivered our strongest month since launch, demonstrating increased adoption and growing confidence in the brand.

ledger.quote: For the full year, we can consider around 25%.
ledger.speaker: Jayashree Satagopan
ledger.target: tax rate around 25% for full year
ledger.verdict: Full year FY26 effective tax rate came in at 23.9%, meeting 25% guidance.
ledger.evidence: FY26 PBT 15119.0, PAT 11509.0, implied tax rate 23.9%

ledger.quote: We expect to launch in the second half of the fiscal year.
ledger.speaker: Richard Ascroft
ledger.target: launch in second half of fiscal year
ledger.by_when: second half of the fiscal year
ledger.verdict: Targeted US product launch in second half of FY26 was achieved.
ledger.evidence: In the month of June, we surpassed 1,000 prescribers, and we also delivered our strongest month since launch, demonstrating increased adoption and growing confidence in the brand.

ledger.quote: So, we currently have three facilities that are under warning letter from the US FDA. Mohali, Dadra, and Halol.
ledger.speaker: Aalok Shanghvi
ledger.verdict: Resolution of warning letters for Mohali, Dadra, and Halol facilities remains pending.

ledger.quote: So Neha, I think we should come in the lower end of the guidance overall, that's what is our assessment today.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.verdict: FY26 actual R&D spend was not disclosed in reported numbers or call transcript.

ledger.quote: We are publishing phase-2a data in the certain scientific conferences, both for diabetes as well as for NASH over the next few months.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.target: Publish phase-2a data in scientific conferences
ledger.verdict: Publishing phase-2a diabetes and NASH data received no update on latest call.

ledger.quote: But the current phase-2b study which has started, that should possibly get over within maybe 12-to-18 months.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.verdict: Phase-2b study completion target of 12 to 18 months from Feb 2026 remains pending.

ledger.quote: On the guidance, we expect high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding of the regulatory and macro environment.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.target: high single-digit consolidated top line growth
ledger.verdict: FY27 high single-digit top-line growth guidance remains pending with Q1 revenue up 10.1%.
ledger.evidence: Think we should stick on to the high single-digit growth for the full year.

ledger.quote: We expect our FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of the sales for the next year.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.verdict: FY27 R&D spend guidance of 6% to 7% remains pending; Q1 spend was 5.4%.
ledger.evidence: Consolidated investments towards R&D for Q1 FY27 stands at INR8,264 million or 5.4% of sales.

ledger.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 FY27.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
ledger.verdict: Organon acquisition remains on track for completion in Q4 FY27.
ledger.evidence: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 of financial year '27 and an integration management office has been working on day one preparedness.

ledger.quote: Yes. We expect the effective tax rate to be in the range of 25%.
ledger.speaker: Jayashree Satagopan
ledger.verdict: FY27 tax rate target around 25% is pending; Q1 FY27 rate was 27.8%.
ledger.evidence: Effective tax rate for the quarter was at 27.8% versus 24.3% in Q1 FY26.

read: Management delivered on its FY26 US product launches and full-year tax guidance. Next due are FY27 top-line growth of high single-digits and the Organon transaction closing in Q4 FY27.
questions: What is the updated timeline for filing the Ilumya psoriatic arthritis sBLA?
When will the phase-2a trial data for diabetes and NASH be published in scientific conferences?
What is the status of resolving FDA warning letters at Mohali, Dadra, and Halol facilities?
bull: US innovative launches Unloxcyt and Leqselvi executed on schedule with over 1,000 Leqselvi prescribers.
Q1 FY27 revenue grew 10.1% YoY to Rs 15,300 crore, maintaining double-digit top-line momentum.
FY26 tax rate delivered at 23.9%, meeting guidance.
bear: Management provided no updates on Ilumya PsA sBLA filing or phase-2a diabetes and NASH data.
Q1 FY27 effective tax rate rose to 27.8%, up from 24.3% in Q1 FY26.
US FDA warning letters on Mohali, Dadra, and Halol facilities remain unresolved.
